title: Pembayaran berhasil!
text: Mantaap, kamu barusan bayar Rp26.374 ke PT KEPO SOLUSI INDONESIA.
notes: A plain KELUAR from GoPay. Nothing to match, no pair.
The merchant is the legal entity name, not a storefront name — keterangan will read 'PT KEPO SOLUSI INDONESIA' unless it gets prettified later.
Copy voice matters for the parser: 'Mantaap, kamu barusan bayar X ke Y.' The amount sits mid-sentence, so an anchor on the start of the string would miss it.
